title: valence-flip-approach-commit
log_line: Valence flip: same 24-frame loom gate, ESCAPE_SIGN -1 occupies the crossing Y (approach), +1 flees. Contact, not placement. Open-hit is not a success metric. Not a fly result. Self-play stays locked.
hypothesis: Sign-flipping loom from leave-the-point to occupy-the-crossing-Y yields contact ≥ landing_commit and is just a goalie, not placement. Open-hit is not a success metric.
what: Motor remap on the existing 24-frame commit gate. Default is hold or the existing centering reflex. Incoming and t_to_line ≤ 24 and reachable: drive toward the predicted crossing Y (reflect if that bounce is inside the window). Escape is the opposite sign. No new retina. No new aim head.

rule.commit: incoming AND t_to_line <= 24 AND reach <= t_to_line
rule.y_target: y_ball + v_y * t_to_line; reflect top/bottom if that bounce is in the window
rule.on_commit: dy = clip(ESCAPE_SIGN * k * (y_paddle - y_target)). ESCAPE_SIGN -1 approach, +1 flee.
rule.estimate: 32-ommatidia COM for y_ball and COM delta for v_y

do_not: Change public/ or the browser PPO.
Add a new aim head, desired_offset, or self-play.
Stamp lag 40/40 or PPO 99/100 as a result of this.
Count open-hit as a success metric.
Write a C hypothesis from this file.

pass.rule: Vs frozen Phase A, approach_commit contact_rate >= landing_commit mean contact_rate. Open-hit is logged and is not a pass key. Lag matches are reported and are not a title.
